Dear Peggy,

Please be advised that the status of the Buck Blankets and the Bucks Hood Ornaments follows.
The last shipment of blankets was shipped from Faribo on April 21, 1992. They should be arriving Friday, April 24th or Monday, April 27th. This last shipment completes the order.

2041552757

Forty-six hood ornaments shipped on April 23rd) The balance of the order, 354 pieces, is ready at this time; however, we are still waiting for bases. The bases will arrive at R.S. Owens sometime during the week of April 27th. Once they arrive, the units will be assembled, packaged and prepared for shipment to Kankakee. Rick feels that all 354 remaining pieces should arrive at Kankakee during the week of May 4th. I will stay in touch with you as to the date the bases come in.

If you have any other questions, please do not hesitate to call.

Sincerely,

RUSSELL SPECIALTIES CORPORATION
